test: Identify SO lines with qty_shipped > 0 and no (or lower) invoiced qty via finance_invoice_lines.line_id. Break down by year, ship_day distance to cut-off, fulfilment, branch, customer, sku, order channel, number of invoices per order, fractional qty. Check WMS sale movements (ref_id=order_id + sku + branch) confirm goods left. Check whether any later invoice ever covers them. Size at line price per year for 2016-2024.
support: Stable yearly count/rate 2016-2024 relative to shipped lines; WMS sale movements exist for the lines; no later invoice; concentration in a fulfilment type, multi-invoice orders, or particular branch/pattern; not driven by fractional opening-balance quantities.
weaken: No WMS sale for these lines (qty_shipped wrong); concentration in 2016 fractional quantities; most in final weeks before cut-off; or orders otherwise invoiced via another line (e.g. billed under different line).
expect: Moderately confident (~65%) the leak is steady and real in the records: WMS sales exist and rate is flat ~0.02% of lines per year. Expect it to be spread fairly evenly across branches/fulfilment (possibly a generated random drop), so 'cluster' part may fail. 2025 excess likely cut-off.
